question: Through which of the following states of India does the Tropic of Cancer NOT pass?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **imaginary line at 23.50 degrees north of the equator is known as the Tropic of Cancer.**
 
• The **Tropic of Cancer crosses eight Indian states**: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura, and Mizoram.
 
• The **State of Odisha is not a part of it.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tropic of Cancer**

 
 
• **​**The Tropic of Cancer, commonly referred to as the **Northern Tropic**, is the northernmost circle of latitude on Earth where the Sun can be directly overhead.
 
• This happens in June when the **Northern Hemisphere** is tilted most strongly toward the Sun.
 
• Additionally, it sinks to **90 degrees below the horizon at solar midnight on the December Solstice.**
 
• The circle is presently** 23.43631° north of the Equator, **according to a formula that is updated regularly.
 
• The** tilt of the earth's axis** with respect to the plane of its orbit is **23 degrees and 27 minutes**.
 
• This tilt is also known as the **earth's declination**.
 
• At noon on June 21, the **sun** is at **23.5° north and is parallel to the earth's surface.**
 
• This is why a **globe** has a designation for the **Tropic of Cancer.**
